preconditions.description: Attacker must have DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE or be able to obtain it through the setRoleSuperAdmin function
The contract must have some FIT token balance for the attacker to steal

exploit_hint: As the contract owner (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE), call setRoleSuperAdmin to transfer admin role to attacker address if not already admin. Then use the admin privileges to grant yourself MINTER_ROLE and mint unlimited tokens to your address, or use BOSS_CONTROL_ROLE to set addressForBosses to your address and call withDraw() to drain contract tokens. Alternatively, use SWEEPER_ROLE to swap contract tokens for ETH sent to addressForBosses (which you control).
